title: Connect, change, check, repair or disconnect a Gitea connection
description: POST /api/v1/integrations/gitea sends connect, replace, check or repair; DELETE sends disconnect. The token travels only in connect and replace, goes once to the mapped daemon, which validates it against the base's /user and writes it into tea's own login file, and is never returned, logged or kept anywhere else. connect infers https:// only when no scheme is given and never corrects a host. connection_id is one the daemon derived from tea's file; it selects nothing else. check reads /user now; the list never touches the network. repair registers the secretless Git credential helper for the connection's base again. disconnect removes the local tea entry only: it revokes nothing at Gitea and leaves every clone in place, and it is refused while one of this daemon's clones uses the connection.

token.description: A Gitea personal access token: printable ASCII without spaces.
